sloka: हत्वा क्रूरम् दुराधर्षम् देव ऋषीणाम् भयावहम् ।दश वर्ष सहस्राणि दश वर्ष शतानि च ॥१-१५-२९॥
transliteration: hatvā krūram durādharṣam deva ṛṣīṇām bhayāvaham ।daśa varṣa sahasrāṇi daśa varṣa śatāni ca ॥1-15-29॥

translations.english: Lord Visnu, supreme soul having given boon to devatas in this manner, reflected as to the place where he should take birth as a man in this world of men.
